Autumn at The Square

Description
The leaves are falling, and the holiday season is right around the corner! Get a head start on your holiday shopping at Autumn at the Square on Saturday, November 7th, at The Music Man Square. Shop a variety of local vendors, discover unique gifts, and enjoy a fun day of shopping from 11 AM to 4 PM. Don’t miss the raffle drawing at 3 PM! For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/events/29039969495629130. 

The Music Man Square

308 South Pennsylvania Avenue, Mason City, IA 50401
Nov 07, 2026
11:00 AM CST to 4:00 PM CST
